svg.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
svg.aria-label: A write in copy mode: ublk_drv first copies the request pages into the server buffer of tag 3, then completes the FETCH command. The server writes its buffer to the backing file and sends COMMIT_AND_FETCH.
